intro: Xiamen is the most interesting coastal listening in mainland China, because of where it is. Kinmen is visible from the beach and is administered from Taipei, so the broadcast band here carries stations from both sides, and the marine band carries a genuinely international mix. The Taiwan Strait is one of the busiest shipping lanes in the world and the traffic runs right past. Add a busy container port, a hub airport on an island, and subtropical humidity that does interesting things to VHF, and there is a lot going on.
introz: 厦门是中国大陆最有意思的滨海收听地点，原因在于它的位置。金门在海滩上就能看见，由台北管辖，所以这里的广播频段能收到两岸的电台，海事频段上的船舶构成也真正国际化。台湾海峡是全球最繁忙的航道之一，船流就从眼前经过。再加上繁忙的集装箱港、建在岛上的枢纽机场，以及亚热带湿度对 VHF 产生的有趣影响，这里的内容相当丰富。

stations.d: Gaoqi sits on the island itself, so approaches come in over the water and you can hear them from the waterfront.
stations.dz: 高崎机场就在岛上，进近航路从水面上过来，在海边就能听到。

stations.n: No continuous weather radio in China
stations.z: 中国没有连续气象广播
stations.d: No NOAA equivalent, but the Maritime Safety Administration broadcasts navigation and weather warnings after announcing on Ch 16 — which in typhoon season is the thing to listen for.
stations.dz: 没有对应 NOAA 的广播，但海事局会在 16 频道预告后播发航行与气象警告——台风季节这就是要守的内容。

stations.z: 2 米 FM 呼叫频率（IARU 三区）
stations.d: Over-water paths across the bay work remarkably well. From Gulangyu or the Xiamen University hills you cover a lot of the strait.
stations.dz: 跨海湾的水面路径效果出奇地好。在鼓浪屿或厦大后山上能覆盖大片海峡水域。

stations.z: APRS 数据 · 一区与三区
海事 16 频道 · 遇险与呼叫
stations.d: The strait carries a very large share of world container traffic, and the local fishing fleet works the same band.
stations.dz: 海峡承载了全球集装箱运输中相当大的份额，本地渔船也在同一频段上作业。

stations.z: 海事 13 频道 · 船桥互通
stations.d: Container ships, ferries and fishing boats in a narrow, crowded channel.
stations.dz: 狭窄拥挤的水道里，集装箱船、渡轮和渔船并行。

stations.n: Port working channels — scan Ch 06 to Ch 14
stations.z: 港口工作频道 · 扫 06 至 14 频道
stations.d: Chinese VTS centres use various channels between 06 and 14 depending on the port. Listen on 16 for the handoff and follow it.
stations.dz: 中国的船舶交通管理中心根据港口不同，使用 06 至 14 之间的频道。在 16 频道等交接通告，然后跟过去。

stations.n: 无线列调 — conventional railway dispatch
stations.z: 无线列调 · 普速铁路调度
高铁 · GSM-R 数字系统

stations.d: Both sides of the strait are audible here, and at night the band fills with stations from across Southeast Asia.
stations.dz: 海峡两岸的电台在这里都能收到，入夜后频段上挤满东南亚各地的信号。

stations.n: 公安 350 MHz — encrypted PDT digital
stations.z: 公安 350 MHz · PDT 数字加密
